notes.title: Japanese loc. Optimization fixes, Xbox release
notes.content:
Greetings,

[h3]Japanese loc. Optimization & performance fixes[/h3]

We want to share that the game has received an update with Japanese localization. Moreover, we have successfully updated the optimization of the game, leading to faster loading times between levels, reduced overall game size, improved stability, and fixes for crashes caused by memory overflow.

[h3]Xbox release[/h3]

We are delighted to inform you that the Xbox port is OUT! The PlayStation and Switch versions are in progress and will be launched within the next month or two after the Xbox release. Our main priority was to ensure optimal performance on each console, which led to extended quality assurance testing for each build beyond our initial plans.

Here is our message to the Japanese audience:

日本の皆様へ

 本ゲームの日本語ローカライゼーションの大幅な遅れに対し、心よりお詫び申し上げます。初期のローカライゼーションで予期せぬ問題が発生し、最高の品質を確保するまでリリースを見送るという難しい決断を下すこととなりました。 

しかし、喜ばしいお知らせです。日本語ローカライゼーションはついに完成し、その品質に自信を持っております。SteamとXboxプラットフォームで「There is No Light」を日本語でお楽しみいただけるようになりました。Nintendo SwitchとPlayStationに対しては、移植への取り組みを精力的に行っております。今後のアップデートにご期待ください。

 改めて、この度の大幅な遅れに対してお詫び申し上げると共に、皆様の忍耐とサポートに心から感謝しております。私共は日本語で素晴らしいゲーム体験をお届けすることを心待ちにしており、皆様に楽しんでいただけることを願っております。 

当コミュニティの一員としてご参加いただき誠にありがとうございます。引き続き、「There is No Light」への温かいご支援をお願い申し上げます。  

Zelart一同

notes.title: There is No Light: Enhanced Edition - A free upd. on Jan. 7!
notes.content:
Hello everyone and Happy New year!

[h1]There is No Light: Enhanced Edition[/h1]

[h3]Since the game’s launch we’ve been working on the biggest post-release update for There Is No Light, and we’re finally ready to announce that a free Soul Harvest update will be out on January 7! With this update we’ve also managed to complete the roadmap we announced last year, so numerous improvements have been made: the side part of Caves of Rebirth location is now available even after completing the sidequest, the combat system as a whole has been rebalanced, surface readability - enhanced, and so on. [/h3]
[h2]With the biggest update ever, we’re releasing the final edition of the game – There is No Light: Enhanced Edition![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/22fcd133bdf4877da0e15e85524aa4c973665b54.png[/img]

[h1]Soul Harvest update[/h1]

[h3]With the Soul Harvest update, our main goal was to improve the combat system, to make it more interesting, flexible and enjoyable. The feedback we received during the closed playtest demonstrates that we managed to achieve that goal.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/b714121b0362c25fcb2636873e18124c29425e0f.png[/img]

[h3]The main update feature is a new "Soul Harvest" mechanic added to the game, which greatly enhances There Is No Light combat system. The Soul Harvest allows the hero to obtain new abilities from defeated bosses. A total of 14 new abilities have been added, each of which can be improved with Death Essences. The souls are applied to the weapon of your choice, but some effects can extend to other weapons as well. Different combinations of souls allow you to customise the gameplay that suits you best.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/d57dd033a40f87e4c1b050398a46590b8c2c639c.png[/img]

[h3]Fallen Champion[/h3]
After using the chosen weapon's ability or a successful block, the hero is able to make a fire dash.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/4145a5bbd4dd136692dcdaaf6c3d05f64fe340f8.gif[/img]

[h3]The Traitor who killed her[/h3]
Increases the experience gained from killed enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/25b9a5516229947982568c4489c3c750e43e9f75.gif[/img]

[h3]The Weakling who didn’t save her[/h3]
The hero sees dialogues that can change karma.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/ff4c50574f97be15574b572b2637434a63ac1901.gif[/img]

[h3]Homunculus: The child of memories[/h3]
When taking damage, the Healing Shard scale increases by 1.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/c4adea0122839ab9f9c125b3ff121a21cdc46a77.gif[/img]

[h3]Skoll And Hati [/h3]
Increases the damage of all weapons' abilities by 1.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/9afc1d1d128526aacf216cedffc2d7874c95cad5.gif[/img]

[h3]Sabnock [/h3]
The Healing Shard restores 2 HP.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/5a572c29d1185a9d4c27b7f732f2ff7d239193ff.gif[/img]

[h3]Behemoth[/h3]
Each continuous attack on an enemy increases the hero's attack speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/d9dbfa4cb9c08bf4b9cc3583548ffbc9764b9d8e.gif[/img]

[h3]Corelia[/h3]
The hero takes no damage when he falls into the abyss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/8be13f7f158057971bd256eee1882181ab7e2333.gif[/img]

[h3]Aircraft Captain[/h3]
Increases the white life recovery time of enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/5e322e59c7528811b35c20d4b9ce29eedf66d826.gif[/img]

[h3]Tainted[/h3]
After applying the chosen weapon's ability or a successful block, a copy appears that replicates the hero's attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/261b6f540e650cf2658442b43488136a058a4221.gif[/img]

[h3]Son of the Fly King[/h3]
If an enemy attack is successfully interrupted, the selected weapon's ability deals an additional 1 damage point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/a7dd9c33313cb3033636074f96a34f7d8a4da1a5.gif[/img]

[h3]Traitor[/h3]
Blocks lethal damage once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/13a57869ec39b9ecd126ae12c0758c799d6a8be1.gif[/img]

[h3]Nameless[/h3]
When the Dash button is held up, the hero switches to a fast run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/7bf47bd829bbd41b79f088cf07758dd3e942d312.gif[/img]

[h3]Lee, the Ripper’s apprentice[/h3]
Increases running speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/601921cfc5f658169e2b338a61fdfe23d2150415.gif[/img]

[h3]A number of other changes have also been made:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Rebalance of most enemies
[*] Changed costs of Hero's skills
[*] Improved surface readability
[*] Daily backup of saves. Now a backup of your saves will be created upon game launch in "C:\Users\UserName\AppData\LocalLow\ZelartGames\ThereIsNoLight", so you won't lose your progress in case of unforeseen circumstances or an error in the game. 
[*] Minor fixes and tweaks
[/list]

Thank you!

[list]
[*] 🐦 [url=https://twitter.com/ThereNoLight]Twitter[/url]
[*] 👾 [url=https://discord.gg/B36WW4S]Discord[/url]
[*] 👩‍💻 [url=https://www.facebook.com/ThereIsNoLightGame]Facebook[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings!

We're happy to announce this week's update 🎃
We are really thankful for all the feedback we're getting, and we're happy and willing to continue the game's improvements![/h3]

[h2]Update's list:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added option to remove black frames for widescreen monitors. To do this, change the new "Cropping frame" option in-game settings to "Letterbox".
[*] Fixed a bug with the quest ring which could be picked up 2 times after protecting Spiritina.
[*] Karma meter now appears before the use of karma doors and first-aid kits
[*] Removed the opportunity to jump on the final moving platform in the "Vault of Heaven" location, skipping all the previous ones in the section with the fire tubes
[*] Passages to karma doors in the "Vault of Heaven" location have been moved to make them easier to find
[*] Added weapon swap icons to Superbia and Mendacium tutorials
[*] Added information to the first-aid kit tutorial that first-aid kits do not restore after being used
[*] Updated save logic for localization, which should potentially fix bugs with non-saved localization for some players
[*] Fixed the disappearance of the glass on the bartender's counter at Central Station.
[/list]

notes.title: 🚨 New Roadmap!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings!

We're happy to announce a new Roadmap of improvements for the next few months!
Some features will be implemented/done fairly soon, and some of them will take us longer to complete. We'll update you about all upcoming improvements.

🎯 The biggest update, which will also require us more time to complete is: "the New Hero's abilities obtained from the Souls of slayed Bosses" -- it allows you to enhance the Hero and get new abilities for the souls of the slain bosses.

notes.title: New Update! ROADMAP for the next week 🚀 Game's OST
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings!

We're happy to announce a new update for the game! Be warned, there are quite a lot of fixes and rebalancing improvements![/h3]

[list]
[*] Depot location. Rebalanced the placement and number of enemies. Reduced the number of enemy waves in the arena.
[*] Path of Sorrow location. Rebalanced the placement and number of enemies. Reduced the number of enemy waves in the arena. Reduced the number of exploding barrels.
[*] Waters of Purification location. Removed a couple of enemies. Reduced the number of enemies in the arena.
[*] Absolute location. Fixed a spot where you could get stuck.
[*] Mind of a Fool location. Reduced the number of enemies. Reduced the number of exploding barrels.
[*] Abyss location. The number of enemies and explosive barrels on tankers was reduced. A first aid kit was added. Increased amount of jumps with two directions - up and down. Fixed a bug with incorrect save.
[*] Caves of Rebirth location. Changed the amount of health for soldiers with mace.
[*] Vault of Heaven location. Exiting the Vault of Heaven after defeating a boss has become more obvious.

[*] Reduced the HP of wax creatures and birds in Mind of a Fool location to 4.
[*] Decreased karma cost for special doors and first aid kits.
[*] Increased time for giving answers in the dialogues.
[*] Disabled interactive butterflies in the spots where collectibles were picked.
[*] Added an explanation in English that after a mode change, the game will restart from the last save point.
[*] Updated the icons on the map of Central Station.
[*] Removed the effect on dialog boxes in the Archive of the Firsts.
[*] The Samedi Butterfly in the beginning of the game now guides the player to the screen for the transition to the battle with the Hand.
[*] Minor tweaks and fixes.
[*] The mode change prompt now appears even when the interface is hidden.
[*] Fixed misprints.

notes.title: Day-one update is live!
notes.content:
Hi!
Thank you all for the feedback. Fixed some bugs and erros in day-one update.
[list]
[*] Controls. You can now activate mouse control with a joystick connected. To do this, simply move the mouse to make the game understand that you want to use it. To use a joystick, click on any button on it and control will go to the joystick.
[*] Fixed a few places where the player can get stuck.
[*] Mode change hint will appear less frequently.
[*] Fixed some places where the hero can stuck and a bug with the immortal dog in battle with one of the root giants.
[*] The sequence in the puzzles in the "Caves of Rebith" to open the elevator is now always the same and does not change after an unsuccessful input.
[*] Rewritten the logic of the elevator movement in the "Caves of Rebith", because some players had the elevator moving too slowly.
[/list]

If you found a error or encountered a bug, please write to us and we will try to fix it as soon as possible.
Thank you.
Regards, Zelart.

notes.title: Free ver. of There is No Light! Black Book Release!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone!

We’re back with some awesome news! Just in a few weeks, we’re releasing a free ver. of There is No Light with an exclusive Arena mode! Apart from Arena, the game will contain three locations and a Boss fight that you might have seen in our last demo that was released during the last Steam Next Festival.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1700700/There_Is_No_Light_616/

[h3]
This free ver. will be called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1700700/There_Is_No_Light_616/]There is No Light 616[/url] and will be available for a limited time period, so hurry to install the game in the very first days after release![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/cd72d1667005f60849bd2e02d755f331641489bd.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/72c41ddfe8a66f852fcef50c3e4395aad3469a63.png[/img]

[h3]So, why does [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1700700/There_Is_No_Light_616/]There is No Light 616[/url] deserve your attention if you have played our last demo back in June?

[list]
[*]
We’ve gathered all the feedback from you and very much improved the demo according to it. The enemies and combat system became more diverse and better, the healing system also became more accessible plus the demo has a much better tutorial. So if there was anything that made you feel confused or maybe even disappointed the last time you tried the demo, there is a huge chance that you’ll be surprised by how much the game has changed since then!

[*]New! Arena! Mode![/list][/h3]

[h1]Black Book is coming out TODAY[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138660/Black_Book/

[h3]We're excited to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138660/Black_Book/]Black Book[/url], an upcoming dark RPG Adventure based on Slavic myths, will come out on the 222nd day of the year 2021 (i.e. August 10). All players will be able to get it with a 15% discount during the first week after the release.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/b474a42ff310a3018790a2757fc4dc51578692b3.jpg[/img]

[h3]There is No Light and Black Book have a lot in common, such as rich storytelling, a grim setting, and a strong protagonist who is fighting the evil forces.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138660/Black_Book/]Black Book[/url] will feature a full English voiceover, extensive story dialogues consisting of more than 150k words, and more than 20 hours of gameplay.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35623874/a8167a8faa0dffcfb1d8d2b31b46313840fb188e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Black Book is a haunting tale of a young sorceress Vasilisa seeking the power of Black Book to revive her beloved one. Fight evil forces in card-based battles and explore the world, where humans live alongside mythological creatures. Dive into the cold, yet alluring world of Slavic folktales — and uncover the secrets that hide in the darkness.[/h3]

[*] 👩‍💻 [url=https://www.facebook.com/ThereIsNoLightGame]Facebook[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Contest Winners! Your Feedback!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[h1]Winners[/h1]

First of all, we want to thank you all for participating in our contest within this demo Festival! We’ve received 5,597 entities and chosen 30 winners! All the emails were sent to the winners, so congrats!

[previewyoutube=wDajqW561KM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Your Fedback[/h1]

The feedback that we've received from you was amazing, it will help us a lot to improve the game! We've carefully gathered each and every feedback we could find, it is very important and valuable for us, so huuuge thank you all!
We're already working on the improvements based on your suggestions, such as:
[list]
[*] [b]Different Game mods[/b]: standard and adventure (easier).
[*] [b]Healing[/b] that includes: additional healing in addition to extra lives.
[*] [b]Controls rework[/b]: key remapping for PC and consoles and dealing with input lag.
[*] [b]Fonts rework[/b] includes improvement of the font's visuals and dialogs' speed regulation.
[*] [b]Polishing of the enemies[/b] from the demo includes reworks of their hitboxes and attack speed.
[*] [b]Additional progression mechanics[/b],
[/list]
And much other staff.

[h1]The epilogue[/h1]
If you've missed our cool teaser of the Release Trailer, here is your chance to watch it again ;)

[previewyoutube=QMCEoBgF36g;full][/previewyoutube]
